title: Acceptance mechanisms and evidence
summary: The cases distinguish further negotiation, private preparation, specified approval, and invited performance.
notes: The offer’s actual terms organize the inquiry. Informal responses and electronic messages may or may not express a commitment. Notice may be waived or required depending on the invitation and likelihood the offeror will learn of performance. The omitted page in Ever-Tite and the unassigned Corinthian opinion remain identified rather than silently completed.
